description:
FILED s473t3 (Opus triage of the 79 CATALOG-only blessed rows), on main
d9a2aac0.  PRE-EXISTING.  Probe: scratch/s473t3/probes/p03-sprintf-missing.pl.

ROWS BEHIND IT (baselines/fail-baseline.tsv, 2 rows):
  sprintf.t 550  `>%3$*4$v*2$.*1$x< >[3, 4, "\x11\x22\x33", "/"]<
                  > 011/ 022/ 033< >four reordered args<`
  sprintf.t 540  `>%*1073741819$v2d< >''< > MISSING<`

REPRODUCER (perl 5.40.3 vs ./runpcl):
    printf("D=[%3\$*4\$v*2\$.*1\$x]\n", 3, 4, "\x11\x22\x33", "/");
  perl: D=[ 011/ 022/ 033]           (no warning)
  PCL : D=[%3$*4$v*2$.*1$x]          + `Invalid conversion in sprintf: "v"`

  and
    printf("C=[%*1073741819\$v2d]\n", '');
  perl: C=[] + `Missing argument in sprintf`
  PCL : C=[%*1073741819$v2d] + `Invalid conversion in sprintf: "v"`

MECHANISM: `%sprintf-star-positional` (added s216) handles `%*N$` and `%.*N$`
for the plain conversions, and the `%v` vector arm handles `%v*d`; the two
have never been combined, so the spec parser hits `v` after a positional
prefix, calls it an invalid conversion and emits the whole spec verbatim.
`%v*d` alone and `%*N$d` alone both WORK (measured).
Fix area: `p-sprintf` / `sprintf-vector` in `cl/pcl-runtime.lisp`.

CATALOG NOTE THIS REPLACES: sweep-bug-catalog.md sprintf.t, "reordered
positional+vector (482/540/543/546)" -- the row numbers in that note are
stale, and 482 is #1472, not this.

FAMILY: sprintf spec parsing.  Sibling: #1472 (warning accounting), #1474
(vector flag application).
subject: BUG (sprintf): a POSITIONAL argument specifier (`N$`) combined with the vector flag `%v` is not parsed at all -- `sprintf("%3$*4$v*2$.*1$x", 3, 4, "\x11\x22\x33", "/")` is ` 011/ 022/ 033` in perl and the SPEC VERBATIM in PCL
